title: First external customer
description: Done when: a greenhouse.toml for the first external customer repo (verify = that repo's own prechecks + the nugit gate; scope = what the build host can verify) drives its approved beads to draft PRs, and that repo's evaluation step has numbers from greenhouse report.

title: Learn stage: rejection -> nugit lesson candidate
description: Done when: a PR closed unmerged with a review comment triggers a learn session that writes a status: proposed lesson under .nugit/lessons/ (scoped to the touched components) on its own draft PR; the human ratifies. Rejection reason recorded in the ledger.

title: Stage state machine (pure)
description: Done when: internal/stage exposes Next(stage, event) -> (stage, action) covering spec/implement/verify/review/parked/learn/done, including retry-once-then-park on verify failure and reject -> learn. No I/O, table-driven tests cover every transition and every invalid one.

title: Skeleton: config + status
description: Done when: `greenhouse status` loads greenhouse.toml (repo path, plan prefix, wip.implement, wip.open_prs, quota.five_hour_max, quota.weekly_share, verify commands, per-stage model/turn budget) and prints every bead in the plan with its stage label, read via `bd list --json` behind an adapter interface with a fake for tests. go test/vet/gofmt clean; workspace.dsl matches imports.
